script: How did a modern European border change overnight? In February twenty twenty-two, Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine, triggering the largest armed conflict on the continent since World War Two. Millions fled their homes, seeking safety across Europe while cities faced devastating bombardment. Despite overwhelming odds, Ukrainian forces mounted a fierce defense, backed by international aid and advanced technology like drones and satellite intelligence. Today, the front lines stretch across hundreds of miles, locked in a brutal war of attrition with global economic and political repercussions. Yet, amidst the destruction, the resilient spirit of ordinary citizens continues to define the human cost and complexity of this ongoing historic struggle.
